errors.evidence: The description fails to mention that this is a stacked bar chart, which is a key structural element for understanding the data composition within each year.
The years on the horizontal axis are in chronological order, not alphabetical order.
The y-axis values are absolute numbers (e.g., 20 000, 40 000), not measured in thousands. Stating they are in thousands would imply the values are 20,000,000, 40,000,000 etc.
The labeled intervals on the y-axis are every 20,000 (0, 20 000, 40 000, etc.), not 10,000.
The legend entry for the yellow category is "Компенсаторни инструменти" (Compensation instruments), not "Компютърни инструменти" (Computer instruments).
